post.description:
Extract structured data from a document using a configured extractor.

Upload a document (PDF, image, or other supported format) along with an extractor ID,
and receive the extracted data matching your extractor's schema.

**File Input Options:**
- **Binary upload**: Directly upload the file (max 4.5 MB)
- **Base64**: Pass base64-encoded file content (max 4.5 MB)
- **Data URL**: Pass a data URL (max 4.5 MB)
- **URL**: Pass a publicly accessible URL to the document (up to 35 MB)

**File Size Limits:**
Binary, Base64, and Data URL inputs are limited to **4.5 MB** on the Pay As You Go plan.
For larger files up to **35 MB**, use the URL option.
Need higher limits? Contact sales at https://runautomat.com/contact

400.description:
The request is malformed or missing required fields.
Check that you've provided all required fields: `file` and `extractorId`.

401.description:
The API key is missing, invalid, or has been revoked.
Ensure you're using a valid API key in the `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` header.

422.description:
The extraction could not be completed. This may occur if:
- The extractor ID doesn't exist or you don't have access to it
- The document format is not supported
- The document could not be processed

500.description: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again or contact support.

extractorId.description:
The unique identifier of the extractor to use for extraction.
You can find this in the Automat dashboard or when creating an extractor via the API.

file.description:
The document to extract data from. Can be:
- A binary file upload
- A URL string (http:// or https://)
- A base64-encoded string
- A data URL string

mimeType.description:
The MIME type of the file. Required when `file` is a string (URL, base64, or data URL).
Examples: `application/pdf`, `image/png`, `image/jpeg`

filename.description:
Optional filename for the document. If not provided, will be inferred from 
the File object name or URL path.

extractorVersionId.description: Pin extraction to a specific extractor version

config.description: Override model configuration for this request

data.description:
The extracted data matching your extractor's schema.
The structure depends on how you configured your extractor.

type_extract:ExtractResponse.description: Response from a successful extraction request
type_extract:ExtractResponse.title: ExtractResponse

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong
